title: Kissed Tender Kenyan Chicken Skewers
description: A tender and flavorful Kenyan dish perfect for a post-workout meal, featuring blackcurrant jam and yuzu-cure for a unique taste experience.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together blackcurrant jam, yuzu juice, olive oil, garlic powder, ginger powder, and salt-free seasoning blend.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Brush the skewers with additional blackcurrant jam during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Remove the skewers from the grill and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
